processed_text: A 61-year-old male daily wage worker reports persistent cough for more than three weeks, weight loss, and night sweats. He recently returned from working in a nearby city. He has not visited a health facility yet due to fear of losing workdays. Appetite has reduced, and he feels breathless while climbing stairs. No prior history of tuberculosis treatment is known, but he lives in a crowded household with poor ventilation.
